Mr. Abernathy, we regret that you were not satisfied with our services. We strive to do our best job cleaning with the best equipment and well-trained employees to service our customers. We have returned several times and are willing to return again for additional treatments, but you refuse, so we will honor our guarantee and refund you the full amount of your upholstery cleaning. We do not feel it fair for us to purchase a new sofa.

We do have all of our customers sign a disclaimer because of so many potential issues that can come up when attempting to clean furniture. We rarely see issues like this, but we want to make customers aware that they are possible. Manufactures don't always design their furniture with the understanding that it will need to be cleaned, so fabrics, cushions, and backings can have adverse affects when being attempted to clean. Although we don't know what the issue is in this situation, it appears to me to be a PH imbalance that could be corrected with an acidic treatment. It doesn't appear to be because of any chemical we use, or burning with "too hot" water (we offer steam cleaning services, so the water will necessarily be hot). 

I have apologized and will apologize again that our technicians made a guess as to what was causing the issue. They did not do it to insult, just to attempt to understand the issue. We pride ourselves on delivering great customer service and getting great reviews, so we are saddened that the situation has come to this.

Thank you for your past business and we wish you the best in the future.

Great service, great product.

Edited 5/30/16 to add: Did I really write this in Jan. 2014? Still love Brimley's.

7/22/18: Yep, still love Brimley's.

I was impressed with each interaction from Brimley's. The phone call inquiring about service was informative and professional, they cleaning itself was great-carpets look fantastic and the young men who visited our home were nothing but kind and professional. They are hard workers, and very considerate of your needs. 

Look no further, this is your carpet cleaning business from here on out. It sure will be mine.

Review: Using ChemDry in other states, I was always satisfied. As you said, nobody's perfect but we do try hard. Thanks, again, for your feedback and time. I'm glad it worked out in the end - JoAnn

Review:

He was very explanatory about the process, he listened to us with our concerns about the carpets and our plans for them. He explained the entire process, including the treatment for pet stains, the process for removing dog hair from the carpets, what we can expect after the carpets have been cleaned, what to do with the carpets in their care in the future and was very responsive to our desire to modify the carpet cleaning process today for for our particular needs. 
I strongly recommend Brimley's; and Chance Anderson who did our cleaning today was fantastic. 
This is a great company and we would use them at a drop of a hat for any of our carpet cleaning needs in the future. 
Chance's card is going to go into a really safe place because we feel we got a great value and were treated in a highly professional and competent manner. 
Thank you Brimley's White Glove Chem-Dry; you guys are fantastic, and thank you Chance for doing such an awesome job today!!!

They came a couple of weeks ago and did a carpet cleaning  $500 for the whole house... days later I have found a nail , some dog food from the dog who lived and the cArpet  just doesn't smell clean. .. I feel kinda played...
Reply Text: We apologize that we didn't live up to this customer's expectations. We have attempted to contact them but our calls haven't been returned. There were no odor concerns from the customer and the $500 included cleaning a sectional as well. Because the customer was moving in, they chose an additional service of sanitizing (carpet & upholstery) to kill germs and bacteria which also added to the cost. Although our techs are very thorough and our systems powerful, we regret that something like a nail would somehow be missed. We always try to knock our customers socks off with cleaning results AND service but we missed the mark for this customer. We apologize for that and regret we didn't have an opportunity to make things right. We always appreciate feedback and the opportunity to improve!

Review: I love Brimley's White Glove Chem-Dry carpet cleaning. I called to get a quote to have my carpets cleaned and Joann gave me a reasonable quote and said she could fit me in on the same day...Saturday... WOW! Wonderful service! Had my carpets cleaned today and my house smells so wonderful,  very natural and non toxic.  Every spot i wanted cleaned came up and my carpets look brand new again.  Chance was friendly,  efficient,  and punctual.  He even left me a bottle of the cleaner they use for spots in the future.  Would definately recommend to anyone wanting carpets cleaned.  The person who booked my appointment was also very nice,  and the whole process very easy.

Reply Text: YAY - Phil loves the challenge of eliminating spots that a customer didn't think would come out. I love his attention to detail. Glad you were thrilled - JoAnn

This company always does a fantastic job ! The technicians are always extremely helpful, and efficient- willing to go the extra mile- helping to move items, etc. Chance was our tech the last 2 times and he was wonderful ! Highly recommend this company- the scheduling staff is also extremely helpful and friendly.

Dave and David did an excellent job on the tile and grout at my home. They also cleaned some carpet and an area rug. It's amazing how much happier having clean floors can make you!  The guys were very nice and professional. When you have kids, these are the type of people you want in your home. I got an appt right away, they did excellent work and were kind and professional. Even got a very nice, personal thank you from them. Always use Chem Dry on carpet. Stays cleaner longer and dries so quickly!
Reply Text: Thank you, Kelly! We pride ourselves on our clean-cut technicians and aim for the very best service AND cleaning so we're glad to hear that formula works for you :) Thanks so much for taking the time to share your experience with others - it makes a world of difference to us! We hope to be of service again - JoAnn

Review:
I was scheduled to have carpets cleaned and some of my tile by another  reputable company that I have used for 3 years.....day of scheduled appointment, owner calls and says he is really behind... that was 9:30, appointment was between 9-10:00. I called around 11:00 and left text message... no response until 12:30... he was ill but would be out in an hour... I told him I have moved on. Omg, within 5 mins he was able to get a team out by 2:30. Casey and Ryan came and did such a fantastic job!! They were very knowledgeable about the company's products and system they used and answered every question I asked. My very clean carpets dried in one half the time as the previous company that used a different water based system. I want to say "thank you Mike for taking the stress out of my day and also to Casey and Ryan!"  I will see you next year
For sure!! 
My best to you all!

I didn't catch the cleaning Tech's name but he was completely professional, worked around other cleaning people who were in the house without disruption, and did a completely great job. Based on my experience with this one tech I would use this service again.
Rob arrived before his scheduled time.  He was fast, efficient and cleaned my carpets as if they were his own.  I highly recommend Brimley's and Rob's expert service!

Highly recommend these guys. Friendly receptionist got me Saturday appt. Phone quote pretty close to final bill. Tech Jacob was outstanding. Called ahead and was on the early side of the 2 hour window..Also grateful for the short window. Jacob was very conscientious with his work and very mindful of my animals..very pleased with the work and getting out cat urine smell. Even left me a bottle of pet odor cleaner..

My experience was wonderful with this company! Rob had exceptional customer service and I am so thankful I used Brimleys White Glove Chem Dry not only because of their products but mainly because Rob's level of professionalism. Thank you Rob!!
Fast and good - just make sure you know how the pricing works per square foot in advance

I just removed a less than stellar review of this business based upon my service experience last week.  Since that time Brimley's has been back in touch and offered an olive branch and a service credit for my trouble.  I appreciate the follow-up and feel it only fair to post this information also.  I will be using their services again and fully expect my future service calls to be as pleasant as in years past.

I have used Brimley's multiple times for carpet cleaning and to clean our outdoor furniture.  They do great work, are always on time, always call to let you know when they are coming.  Dave was professional and did a great job.

My carpet is over 10 years old and I have been getting it cleaned regularly by different companies that use a different method.  Before I had it cleaned by Brimley's I was seriously thinking about replacing it.  I had my carpet cleaned 2 weeks ago by a young man named Chance and I have been waiting to post a review because usually all the old spots that were present before the cleaning start to reappear about a week after the cleaning.  I am happy to report that the carpet still looks great!  The whole experience from scheduling the cleaning to having the work done was very positive!

From my initial phone call asking for service, all the way through to the follow-up call they made the next day, everyone was professional and courteous. Dave, who cleaned my carpets, was fantastic! He showed up on time, professionally and cleanly dressed, asked the right questions, and made me feel comfortable right from the start. The carpet looks great, the stains have been removed and I am happy with the results. I highly recommend Brimley's White Glove Chem-Dry!

Wonderful customer service!  They did a great job on cleaning the carpets of the home we purchased prior to us moving in.  They had to come back out to clean a very soiled area again...and were so nice and helpful!  You can tell this company takes pride in their reputation and puts the customers FIRST!  Who could ask for anything more, right?

Just had my carpets cleaned and I can't say it's any better than other places I have used.  The technician was professional, on time, and very nice.  The prices aren't bad either.  I have to say though that the product being sold isn't as advertised.  On their website they advertise the "8 step cleaning process" and I really only got about 4 of those steps (mind you I did move my own furniture).  The tech came in, looked at the rooms I wanted cleaned, then started the extraction process without even vacuuming or pre-treating. I had to ask about some left over areas that didn't appear clean so he ended up spraying a treatment and re-running the machine over it.  This did not help those areas however and I was told it was just due to wear.  This may be correct but I just didn't feel like I should have had to ask to get a treatment that should have been done in the first place .  The rest of the carpet looked good.  Overall not a bad experience, I just like to get what is advertised.
Reply Text: I'm so sorry we didn't meet your expectations! We do have an 8-step cleaning process and do expect our technicians to follow it on every job. I appreciate the feedback and have shared it with my team so we can be sure everyone is doing everything they can to delight our customers. I hope you will give us another chance someday.
